universe: The 19 unleveraged ETFs already registered in config/dual-horizon.json; no new selected winners.
execution: Signals observe the current adjusted close and take effect at the following session open; costs use actual weight drift. No close-to-same-close fill.
state: Equal initial algorithm weights; sequential updates from the start of the fixed 2010 history; no reset or re-fit for the five-year window.
deviations: Port of the public update rules; invalid/nonfinite values are rejected instead of repaired.
The initial six price observations are warmup; the algorithm then starts from uniform weights.
2% fixed idle cash is outside the unit-simplex algorithm weights.
No allocation cap beyond long-only/unit simplex, so research can expose concentration risk explicitly.
Costs do not feed back into model updates; target weights remain identical between base and stress.
Zero-cost results are diagnostic only, never substituted for acceptance.

upstream.toolbox_reference: Bin Li, Doyen Sahoo, Steven C.H. Hoi (2015), OLPS: A Toolbox for On-Line Portfolio Selection.
